About these 5 rides

Thursday is the big day: 3 of the 5 ride then. The earliest start is Kona Recreational Ride North from Patricio’s at 7:00 am; the latest is Thursday Night Worlds at 5:00 pm. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. All 5 are road rides. All 5 run every week. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 2, 2026.
